annotations.title: Honeypot token check, token risk: red flags plus live DEX liquidity for a Base token before a swap

description: Check a Base token before you swap into it: a high/medium/low risk verdict with named red flags (paused transfers, blacklist, owner-set fees or tax, a mint selector with a live owner, upgradeable proxy, no or thin liquidity, a pair under 7 days old, buys but no sells as a honeypot sign) plus live DexScreener price, liquidity, volume and FDV. Heuristic screening, not a safety guarantee. Use before swapping into an unfamiliar Base token. Example: address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
